items.text: Levi rik onwoŋo tye kede itino awobe adek: Gercon, Kokat kede Merari.
Kokat rik te bedo itino awobe aŋwen; Amuram, Ijar, Kedron, kede Ujiel.
Amuram rik te bedo awobe aryo: Aron kede Muca, karacel kede nyako ame nyiŋe Miriam. Aron te nywalo awobe aŋwen: Nadab, Abiku, Elejar kede Itamar.
Ikwae Eleajar te bedo lubere kit man: Eleajar onywalo Finekaci, Finekaci te nywalo Abicua,
Abicua te nywalo Bukki, Bukki te nywalo Uji,
Uji te nywalo Jerakia, Jerakia te nywalo Merayo,
Merayo te nywalo Amaria, Amaria te nywalo Akitub,
Akitub te nywalo Jadok, Jadok te nywalo Akimaj,
Akimaj te nywalo Ajaria, Ajaria te nywalo Yokanan,
Yokanan te nywalo Ajaria, ame en nat a rik otio tic Obaŋa i ot Obaŋa ame Culeman ogero i Jerucalem,
Ajaria te nywalo Amaria, Akitub,
Akitub dok te nywalo Jadok, Jadok te nywalo Callum,
Callum te nywalo Kilkia, Kilkia te nywalo Ajaria,
Ajaria te nywalo Ceraya, Caraya te nywalo Yekojadak.
Abaka Nebukadnejar rik te tero Yekojadak oko iyi opii karacel kede jo ocele me Juda kede Jerucalem, ame Rwot omie me atera iyi opii.
Levi rik onwoŋo tye kede itino awo be adek: Gercon, Kokat kede Merari.
Ŋat acel acel i akina awobe man rik tye kede itino awo be. Gercon rik obedo papa a Libni kede Cemei.
Kokat te bedo papa a Amuram, Jjar, Kebron kede Ujie!.
Merari te bedo papa a Makli kede Muci,
Ikwae a Gercon ene: Gercom onywalo Libna, Libni te nywalo Jakat, Jakat te nywalo Jima,
Jima te nywalo Joa, Joa te nywalo Ido, Ido, te nywalo Jera, Jera te nywalo Jeaterai.
Ikwae a Kokat ene: Kokat onywalo Aminadab, Aminadab te nywalo Kora, Kora te nywalo Acir,
Acir te nywalo Elkana, Elkana te nywalo Ebiacap. Ebiacap te nywalo Acir,
Acir te nywalo Takat, Takat te nywalo Uriel, Uriel te nywalo Ujia, Ujia te nywalo Cau!.
Ikwae Elkana: Elkana onywalo awobe aryo: Amacar kede Akimot,
Akimot te nywalo Elkana, Elakana te nywalo Jopai, Jopai te nywalo Nakat,
Nakat te nywalo Eliab, Eliab te nywalo Jekoram, Jeroram te nywalo Elkana.
Camwiri rik onywalo awobe aryo: awobi adwoŋ nyiŋe Joel, eka en atidi te bedo Abija.
Ikwae a Merari te bedo e ne: Merari onywalo Makli, Makli te nywalo Libni, Libni te nywalo Cemei, Cemei te nywalo Uja.
Uja te nywalo Cimea, Cimea te nywalo Kagia, eka Kagia te nywalo Acaya.
Magi gin jo ame Daudi rik oketo me loyo tic me wer i kare me woro i Jerucalem, i kare ame doŋ otyeko tero canduk me cik kuno.
I kare ame Culeman mom ru ogero ot woro Obaŋa, gin rik obedo tiyo ticgi kun oleo alea i kema me rwatte, gin obedo tiyo ticgi kun olubo kite ame rik ocikogi kede.
Magi gin jo ame obedo tiyo ticcono karacel kede awobegi: Jo ame oya i doggola a Kokat, gin ene: Keman wot a Joer, ame en rik atel wer, Joel wot a Camwiri,
Camwiri wot Elkana, Elkana wot a Eliel, Eliel wot a Toa,
Toa wot a Jup, Jup wot a Elkana, Elkana wot a Makat, Makat wot a Macai,
Macai wot a Elkana, Elkana wot a Joel, Joel wot Ajaria, Ajaria wot a Jepania,
Jepania wot a Takat, Takat wot Acir, Acir wot Ebiacap, Ebiacap wot a Kora,
Kora wot Ijar, Ijar wot a Kokat, Kokat wot a Levi, eka Levi te bedo wot Icrael.
Acap rik obedo atel wer i dul me aryo. Ikwae mere rik tye kit man: Acap obedo wot a Berekia, Berekia te bedo wot a Cimea,
Cimea te bedo wot a Micael, Macael te bedo wot a Baceya, Baceya te bedo wot Malcija.
Malcija wot Etini, Etini wot a Jera, Jera wot Adaya,
Adaya wot Etan, Etan wot Jima, Jima wot a Cimei,
Cimei wot a Jakat, Jakat wot a Gercon, Gercon wot a Levi.
Etan ame oya iyi doggola a Merari rik te bedo atel wer i dul me adek. Ikwae onwoŋo tye kit man: Etan obedo wot a Kici, Kici wot a Abdi, Abdi wot a Malluk,
Malluk wot a Kacabia, Kacabia wot Amajia, Amajia wot a Kilkia,
Kilkia wot Amji, Amji wot a Bani, Bani wot a Cemer,
Cemer wot a Makli, Makli wot a Muci, Muci wot a Merari, Merari wot a Levi.
Omegogi ame obedo jo Levi rik daŋ opokkigi tic apapat i kema ame obedo ot me woro Obaŋa.

Ento Aron kede awobe mere, gin en a rik mio mot awaŋa i wi keno lam, dok daŋ owano odok a ŋwece kur i wi keno lam, Gin rik oloo tic luŋ i kabedo Acil Meicel, kede mot ame omio me kwanyo bai i kom jo me Icrael, gin rik otio man luŋ kun olubo gin ame rik Muca amiro Obaŋa ocikogi kede.
Awobe Aron ene: Aron onywalo Eleajar ame obedo papa a Finekaci, eka Finekaci te nywalo Abicua,
Abicua te nywalo Bukki, Bukki te nywalo Uji, Uji te nywalo Jerakia,
Jerakia te nywalo Merayot, Merayot te nywalo Amaria, Amaria te nywalo Akitub,
Akitub te nywalo Jadok, eka Jadok te nywalo Akimaj.
Man en lobo ame rik omio baŋ ikwae Aron kede kwir, ame opokkigi kun lubere i doggola i doggola. Jo me doggola a Kokat en ame rik ogeo, kun megi tye kit man,
Gin rik omio lobo me Kebron ame onwoŋo tye i Juda, karacel kede bar me kwattere.
Ento potti luŋ karacel kede pacci luŋ ame onwoŋo tye i ŋet bomagi-nono rik omio luŋ baŋ Kaleb wot a Jepunne.
Itino Aron rik ote pokkigi lobo magi, ame obedo lobo me alara onek: Kebron kede bar me kwattere, Jattir kede bar me kwattere, Libna kede bar me kwattere, Ecitemoa kede bar me kwattere,
Kilen kede bar me kwattere, Debir kede bar me kwattere,
Acan kede bar me kwattere, kede Bet-cemec i bar me kwattere,

I lobo a jo Benjamin rik daŋ ote miyogi iye boma magi kede bar me kwat iye: Geba kede bar me kwattere, Alemet kede bar me kwattere, karacel kede Anatot kede bar me kwattere. Man te miyo wel boma ame omiogi luŋ bedo apar wie adek, me bedo a jo me doggolagi luŋ.
Aco jo me doggola a Kokat odonere te nwoŋo boma apar ame okwanyo i kwir i kom lobo a nucu atekere a Manace,
Aco jo me doggola a Gercom rik ote miyogi boma apar wie adek ame okwanyo iyi akina lobo jo Icakar, Acer, Naputali kede i kom lobo a jo Manace ame tye i Bacan,
Rik daŋ ote miyo boma apar wie aryo baŋ jo me doggola Merani, kun okwanyo i akina lobo a jo Reuben, Gad, kede Jabulon.
Man en kit a rik jo Icrael omio kede jo Levi pacci me bedogi karacel kede bar me kwatgi ducu.
Rik daŋ omiogi boma ocele i lobo a jo Juda, Cimeon, kede Benjamin, kun opokigi kede kwir, Man otimo i kom boma luŋ ame ocoo nyiŋgi malo.
Jo me doggola a Kokat ocele mege rik omio boma me bedo gi kede kakwattege i akina lobo a jo Epraim.
Omiogi boma magi me larre a jo oneko nek: Cekem kere bar me kwatere ame tye i lobo obedo kidikidi, Gejer, kede bar me kwattere,
Jok-meam kede bar me kwattere, Bet-koron kede bar me kakwattere,
Aijalon kede bar me kwattere karacel kede Gat-Rimmon kede bar me kwattere.
Eka i kom lobo a jo Manace ame onwoŋo bedo tuŋ to ote miyogi boma me Aner kede bar me kwattere karacel kede Bileam kede bar me kwattere.

Aco baŋ jo me doggola a Gercom rik ote miyo boma magi kede kakwatgi, I kom lobo a jo Manace ame onwoŋo bedo turj kide omiogi boma magi: Golan ame tye i Bacad kede ka kwattere, kede Acitaron kede bar me kwattere,
Eka i kom lo bo ajo Icakar ote miyogi boma magi: Kedec kede ka kwattere, Daberat kede kwattere,
Ramot kede bar me kwattere kede Anem kede bar me kwattere.
I kom lobo a jo Acer ote miyogi boma magi: Macal kede bar me kwattere, Abdon kede bar me kwattere,
Kukok kede bar me kwattere, kede Rekob i bar me kwattere.
I kom lobo a jo Naputali ote miyogi boma magi: Kadec ame tye i Galilaya kede bar me kwattere, Kamon kede bar me kwattere, kede Kiriataim kede bar me kwattere,
Jo me doggola a Merari ame odonnege rik ote miyo boma magi kede kakwatgi. I lobo ajo Jabulon rik omiogi boma magi: Rimono kede bar me kwattere, kede Tabor kede bar me kwattere,
I kom lobo a jo Reuben ame tye tuŋ anyarolum me kulo Jordan ine Jeriko rik omiogi boma magi: Bejer kede bar me kwattere, Jajar kede bar me kwattere,
Kedemot kede bar me kwattere, kede Mepat kede bar me kwattere.
Aco i kom lobo atekere a Gad ote miyogi boma magi: Ramot ame tye i Gilead kede bar me kwattere, Makanaim kede bar me kwattere,
Kecbon kede bar me kwattere karacel kede Jajer i bar me kwattere.
